mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a potential monetary policy misalignment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which is positive for consumer spending and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) indicates a strong demand for housing, which is a positive signal for the broader economy and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, which is negative for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
